field3d.hint: Drag to rotate; drag up or down to tilt
field3d.noWebgl: This device cannot show the 3D field, so the chart is shown instead.
field3d.aria: Constitution field, 3D. Constitution {constitution}. Deviation {deviation}, {status}. The current ball sits in the {zone} zone. {trail}
field3d.trailCloser: {count, plural, one {# earlier measurement} other {# earlier measurements}}; moving toward balance.
field3d.trailFarther: {count, plural, one {# earlier measurement} other {# earlier measurements}}; moving away from balance.
field3d.trailSame: {count, plural, one {# earlier measurement} other {# earlier measurements}}; little change.
